verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents its own hook mechanism: Postgres functions run automatically at key auth lifecycle points, such as the Custom Access Token Hook that modifies token claims. That is event-triggered custom logic, but it is code-level hooks at fixed points rather than a rule-definition system. Database triggers on auth data come from the underlying Postgres platform and earn no credit. missing for 10: a declarative rule/condition builder, a documented list of supported auth events and actions, AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Customize Auth behavior with Postgres functions at key lifecycle points.
You can use a [Custom Access Token Hook](/docs/guides/auth/auth-hooks/custom-access-token-hook) to add, remove or change claims present in the token.
